source: MMA 2024 — Minuta Mapa de Ruido Gran Santiago Urbano 2023
method: Traffic noise modelling (13 590 km of road network) — vehicle count data from cameras, toll portals and Sistema RED; noise levels computed for 792 km² across 35 urban communes (GSU). Exposure counts = population in cells above OECD threshold.
note: Communes outside the GSU urban perimeter have noise_in_gsu_map=0 and all noise exposure values set to 0 (not modelled).
